parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query for the binary log list.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the current binary log list. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of binary logs to return on each page. Default value: 30.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query for the binary log list.
